WHERE t.team_name = 'Cedevita Olimpija'
WITH p, t, CAST(p.birth_date AS DATE) AS birth, CAST('2026-10-14' AS DATE) AS today
RETURN CAST(date_part('year', today) AS INT64) - CAST(date_part('year', birth) AS INT64) - CASE WHEN date_part('month', today) < date_part('month', birth) OR (date_part('month', today) = date_part('month', birth) AND date_part('day', today) < date_part('day', birth)) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS col1, p.birth_date AS col2, t.team_name AS col3, p.name AS name_player
